title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.118.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics ahead of the v1.118.0 release. This PR consolidates previously divergent implementations and addresses several customer-reported issues where streamed errors and token refresh races produced confusing behavior. Goals: 1) Standardize auth refresh across SDKs so background token refresh does not interrupt an active stream; 2) Provide identical retry semantics for idempotent vs non-idempotent requests and expose configurable backoff hooks; 3) Improve streaming ergonomics (cancellable streams, consistent event shape across SDKs, clear error propagation); 4) Bump SDK package versions for parity and publish-ready release notes. Summary of changes (single-line): unified auth refresh API, new RetryPolicy interface/struct, streaming Reader/AsyncIterator ergonomics fixes, parity tests added, docs and changelogs updated, version bumps. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-2145) - [x] Unit + integration tests added across all SDKs - [x] Cross-SDK compatibility tests in eval-harness updated - [x] Docs/CHANGELOG updated - [x] Release notes drafted Notes on behavior changes: - Token refresh now happens on a separate background task with a short-circuit that attaches refreshed tokens to in-flight requests before the next send. Streams remain active if refresh succeeds; if refresh fails with a 401 and cannot be refreshed, the SDK emits a terminal stream error consistent across languages. - Retries: Default policy now differentiates idempotent requests (auto-retry up to 3) and non-idempotent requests (no automatic retry except when user opts in). SDKs expose the same RetryPolicy surface: max_attempts, initial_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter. - Streaming ergonomics: Python adds an AsyncIterator with context-manager support; TypeScript exposes an async generator and a .cancel() method on the stream object; Go adds a cancellable Reader with ClearError semantics. References: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2199; SUP-512 customer report; previous parity PR series (see pr-112450, pr-116789, pr-121456).
